Same September 2024 curb shed still blocks lower storefront, but cream west-shop carved pilasters and black convenience fascia are clear; no new lower-partition proof.
Long September 2024 approach gives context / contiguous party walls, but 261 is too far for fine detail.

July 2022 date control shifts to a nearer panorama: Kavasutra clearly has blue retractable canopy, cream glass identity / dark left display, right entry and central 261 residential door. East 261 closed silver grille is historical; September 2024 bottle display is used for later state. 259 east smoke shop is historical; 2024 Half moon convenience sign supersedes. Four upper bays on 259/261/263 confirmed; shared red-brick pilaster bands / central escapes vary by facade.
